en_title: K/DA Is Getting an Official Louis Vuitton Art Book Ahead of 'Start a Fire' Comeback
cn_title: 路易威登将推K/DA回归画集
subtitle: 镜头之外的24小时
opus_summary: 拳头游戏与路易威登合作推出K/DA画集，描绘四位成员各自的24小时生活，10月16日发售，收藏版限量400册。女团暌违六年回归的新企划将于10月20日完整揭晓。

paragraphs.en: Riot Games has teamed up with fashion house Louis Vuitton on a K/DA Travel Book. The book’s reveal comes just after the League of Legends girl group announced their return from a six-year hiatus.
paragraphs.cn: 拳头游戏与时装品牌路易威登合作，将推出一本K/DA主题的Travel Book系列画集。这支《英雄联盟》女团刚宣布结束长达六年的休整、正式回归，画集的消息便随之公布。

paragraphs.en: Tempo Point will collect new illustrations of the virtual girl group, envisioning “24 hours within the individual lives of K/DA members Ahri (vocalist), Akali (rapper), Evelynn (vocalist), and Kai’Sa (vocalist and lead dancer/choreographer).” A Standard edition and Collector’s edition will be released online and in select Louis Vuitton locations and bookstores on Friday, October 16.
paragraphs.cn: 《Tempo Point》将收录这支虚拟女团的全新插画，描绘「K/DA成员阿狸（主唱）、阿卡丽（说唱）、伊芙琳（主唱）和卡莎（主唱兼领舞／编舞）各自24小时的生活」。画集标准版和收藏版将于10月16日星期五在线上、部分路易威登门店及书店发售。

paragraphs.en: The Louis Vuitton Travel Books are a series of premium artbooks, compiling images and illustrations from artists around the world. This particular addition to the collection will be available in two formats: a Standard Edition ($68 USD) and a Collector’s Large-Format Edition ($245 USD). Both editions feature the same artwork in six-color printing, collected in a cloth-bound hardcover book with a silk-screened cover.
paragraphs.cn: 路易威登Travel Book是一个高端画集系列，收录世界各地艺术家的图像与插画作品。这本新画集将推出两个版本：标准版售价68美元(约合人民币456元)，大开本收藏版售价245美元(约合人民币1642元)。两个版本收录的画作相同，均采用六色印刷、布面精装，封面采用丝网印刷工艺。

paragraphs.en: Only 400 copies are being printed of the Collector's Edition, which will be available for purchase online on Louis Vuitton’s website , at Louis Vuitton stores, and in select bookstores. The Standard Edition will be available from the same places, and will also be shown off at the upcoming League of Legends Worlds 2026 Fan Fest event scheduled for November 12 to 14 in New York.
paragraphs.cn: 收藏版仅印制400册，将在路易威登官网、路易威登门店及部分书店发售。标准版也将通过上述渠道销售，并将在即将举行的2026《英雄联盟》全球总决赛粉丝嘉年华上展出。该活动定于11月12日至14日在纽约举行。

paragraphs.en: Select Louis Vuitton stores will also have limited-edition signed copies that come with an exclusive vinyl record. Only 30 total copies of this edition will be available.
paragraphs.cn: 部分路易威登门店还将推出附赠独家黑胶唱片的限量签名版，这一版本总共仅有30册。

paragraphs.en: While the Louis Vuitton of it all may seem a bit random, the French fashion house has actually been a consistent collaborator for Riot Games and the virtual girl group.
paragraphs.cn: 路易威登参与其中，乍看或许有些出人意料，但这家法国时装品牌其实一直与拳头游戏及这支虚拟女团保持合作。

paragraphs.en: In 2019, the House served as the official Summoner’s Cup Trophy Trunk provider for the League Worlds Championship. Nicolas Ghesquière, the House’s Artistic Director of Women's Collections, has designed a number of skins for League of Legends, and the House dressed K/DA and guest artist Lexie Liu, who voiced Seraphine, throughout promotions for “MORE.”
paragraphs.cn: 2019年，路易威登为《英雄联盟》全球总决赛官方打造了召唤师奖杯旅行硬箱。品牌女装艺术总监Nicolas Ghesquière曾为《英雄联盟》设计多款皮肤。在《MORE》的宣传期间，路易威登还为K/DA及为萨勒芬妮献声的特邀艺人刘柏辛提供了服装。

paragraphs.en: K/DA, a virtual pop group which debuted with the single POP/STARS in 2018, just teased their first comeback since 2020. The new project was revealed with an image posted to K/DA social accounts , showing each members’ eyes and the tagline “Start a Fire.” The full project will be revealed on October 20.
paragraphs.cn: 虚拟流行组合K/DA于2018年凭单曲《POP/STARS》出道，近日预告了自2020年以来的首次回归。K/DA在社交账号发布了一张图片，公布了这项新企划。图中展示了每位成员的眼睛，并配有「Start a Fire」的标语。完整企划将于10月20日揭晓。

paragraphs.en: Fortiche has been interacting with the official K/DA announcement on various social platforms, suggesting the Arcane studio may have animated a new K/DA music video.
paragraphs.cn: Fortiche在多个社交平台上与K/DA官方公告互动，暗示这家制作《英雄联盟：双城之战》的工作室可能为K/DA制作了新的动画音乐视频。
